instruction: What is the total cost of my cable bills for this year? The bills are in "~/bills/" directory of my file system.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only an answer (the summed total). Knowledge flow: show_profile gives the login username (email), show_account_passwords gives the file_system password, login gives the token, phone.get_current_date_and_time establishes the current year used to filter bill files by the YYYY-MM in their names (listed as required by the task), show_directory on ~/bills/cable (the agent may first list ~/bills with the same action to discover the cable sub-directory) reveals the bill files, and show_file reads each one. Summation cannot be done in STRIPS, so it is encoded as a running-total chain: static (adds-to file before after) facts and a (running-total ?a) fluent; reading each current-year file advances the running total, and the final amount object total-cable-2023 is the answer passed to supervisor.complete_task. The number of current-year files (Jan-Apr 2023, given current date 2023-05-18) is an assumption; at runtime one show_file call is made per current-year file found in the listing, and files from other years are skipped.
